shortDescription: Obtain information about one or many QRadar Rules, with filter options

options.name: id
options.description: Obtain only information of the Rule with provided ID

options.name: name
options.description: Obtain only information of the Rule that matches the provided name

options.name: origin
options.description: Obtain only information of Rules that are of a certain origin

options.name: owner
options.description: Obtain only information of Rules owned by a certain user

options.name: type
options.description: Obtain only information for the Rules of a certain type
